service.name: architecture-cartographer
service.description: Map, validate, and guide migrations between actual scenario architecture and manifest-defined target architecture.

setup.description: Build API and UI assets declared by the manifest-driven lifecycle contract

steps.name: build-api
steps.run: cd api && GOWORK=off go mod download && GOWORK=off go build -o architecture-cartographer-api .

steps.name: install-ui-deps
steps.run: if [ -f ui/package.json ]; then cd ui && (corepack pnpm install --ignore-workspace || pnpm install --ignore-workspace); else echo 'ui/ not present yet'; fi

steps.name: build-ui
steps.run: if [ -f ui/package.json ]; then cd ui && (corepack pnpm --ignore-workspace run build || pnpm --ignore-workspace run build); else echo 'ui/ not present yet'; fi

develop.description: Launch API and Vite dev server

steps.name: start-api
steps.description: Start Go API server in background

test.description: Execute phased test suite via test-genie

steps.name: check-temporal-models
steps.description: Verify formal flow artifacts via the flow-verifier scenario CLI

steps.name: run-tests
steps.description: Run all test phases via test-genie

qdrant.description: Vector database for cross-scenario domain-map semantic search (collection: architecture-cartographer-domains).
qdrant.degraded_behavior: Domain-map search falls back to BM25-style text matching over freshly derived domains; reindex is deferred.

ollama.description: Local embedding role for the domain-map index.
ollama.degraded_behavior: Embedding generation is unavailable; text-mode domain search still works.

reranker.description: Cross-encoder reranker (BAAI/bge-reranker-v2-m3 via TEI) that reorders the dense domain-search shortlist and collapses gibberish leakage to ~0, separating junk from weak-but-real domain matches that overlap in the dense cosine band.
reranker.degraded_behavior: Reranking falls back to raw dense (cosine) order; search still returns results, but honest no-match rejection is weaker until the reranker is reachable.

code-facts.description: Provides import, endpoint, CLI, and proto adoption facts used to enrich domain evidence.
code-facts.degraded_behavior: Audit still runs with graph/domain evidence, but domain enrichment omits code-facts-backed proofs while the dependency is unavailable.

go-code-graph.description: Extracts Go code graphs for cartographer graph snapshots.
go-code-graph.degraded_behavior: Go graph extraction fails for scenarios with Go surfaces until go-code-graph is available.

typescript-code-graph.description: Extracts TypeScript code graphs for cartographer graph snapshots.
typescript-code-graph.degraded_behavior: TypeScript graph extraction fails for scenarios with TypeScript surfaces until typescript-code-graph is available.
